name: Blood Mantra
body:
School transmutation [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level adept 1, bard 1, death mage 1, mesmerist 1, shaman 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area the caster and all allies within a 60-ft. Burst, centered on the caster
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You let out a chant or series of sounds that resound that heightens the blood of you and your allies. For as long as you concentrate on the spell, you and your allies gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws.
